summary: Frontend-only visual verification of color-coded Child/Parent/Teacher role badges & chips on /admin/content. All UI expectations from the review request are met.
verified_behaviors: Content-list 'Visible To' badge for child renders with class 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700' and text 'Child' (data-testid=visible-to-badge-child-<content_id>) — verified on content_8edef32730e2.

ROLE_STYLES constant is symmetric so parent (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700) and teacher (bg-purple-100 text-purple-700) render identically when present; no content in tested subtopic had those roles, but the same code path is proven by the chip verification below.

Edit modal 'Visible To (User Roles)' section renders 3 pill chips with data-testid=visible-to-checkbox-{child|parent|teacher}. Colored dots verified: child=bg-emerald-500, parent=bg-blue-500, teacher=bg-purple-500.

Checked chip styling verified: child (checked) label class includes 'border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700'. Toggling parent from unchecked→checked flips class from 'border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-600' to 'border-blue-400 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700'.
'Warning: No roles selected. Content will not be visible to anyone.' appears when all 3 chips unchecked.
Mobile viewport (390x844): chip container scrollWidth == clientWidth (340px) — no horizontal overflow; chips wrap cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: ContentManagement.jsx is 2738 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting SortableContentItem, form panels, and the ROLE_STYLES/DEFAULT_VISIBILITY constants into separate modules for maintainability. (Pre-existing; not introduced by this change.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is a purely visual admin-only change on /admin/content. To reach the badges: login as admin → /admin/content → click topic row → Subtopics tab → click subtopic → Lesson Plan tab. Radix Tabs do not expose `value` as an HTML attribute; use text selectors like button[role=tab]:has-text('Subtopics'). In the tested Understanding Money → Money Around Me subtopic, all 3 content items had visible_to=['child'] only, so parent/teacher badges weren't visually observed on cards but their styling was fully verified via the modal chips (same ROLE_STYLES constant drives both).
